about: Lines of code (js, mjs, ts, css, html, py) per area, with ~3% slack: tools/budgets.ts. An area over its budget fails lint; raise a budget only with a new reason describing its current contents and size.

..reason: The root holds the server entry point and the Vite, Vitest and Playwright configurations; Vitest sizes its forks to the memory its cgroups leave.

fleet-box.reason: The boxed checker validates generated looks against the library, rig, module chains and light settings.

public.reason: The app and sandbox HTML shells load their browser entry points.

public/css.reason: Creator opt-in rows join responsive Studio, phone disclosures, navigation and full-size tap targets.

public/js.reason: Prepared blur kernels cache exact weights and sums, nearest-LED cells store flat coordinates, and integrated clocks cache repeated reads within a frame; the views load the rig the server names.

public/patterns.reason: Streaks tables per-lane random values and Chase tables common strand ids in frame(), retaining exact fallback calculations outside the tables.

render-box.reason: Parent PID checks stop orphaned library-only bakes between frames, alongside deterministic IDs and streaming FSEQ output.

shared.reason: Shared schemas and pure rules define looks, generated compositions, API data, permissions and playback.

src.reason: The server additionally reads historical library fingerprints and upgrades exact saved copies to current code for imports.

test.reason: Per-account write-limit and look-size tests, generated and refined looks included. Library-only saving and baking is covered on every path (saves, imports, edits of saved custom looks, composites carrying code, bakes from stored frames), alongside Vampire palette browser coverage atomic settings-file writes and the default rig; browser checks build the app once per run and wait on drawn frames.

tools.reason: Tools build and check rig, palette and rose-expansion data, enforce budgets, support development and backups, and benchmark rendering.
